Knowledge facts: part C holds 50 fact blocks (sec18-F01 onward) from physical pages 59 to 61; part C2 holds 11 confusable blocks (sec18-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A names the issuer, the September 2026 revision line and the written-test requirement; question count, passing standard, format and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- AZ-IMPAIR-A-COUNT — written-test question count not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- AZ-IMPAIR-A-PASS — passing standard not printed; nothing shown to learners (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- AZ-IMPAIR-A-FORMAT — item format not printed (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- AZ-IMPAIR-A-TIME — time limit not printed (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- AZ-IMPAIR-A-EDITION — issuer current-edition confirmation pending; issuer page was bot-challenged at intake (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- AZ-IMPAIR-D-TESTS — revocation test wording lacks separating commas (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- AZ-IMPAIR-E-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- AZ-IMPAIR-ETWO-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: impaired-driving, aggressive driving and minor-supply penalties are statutory and can be amended (for example sec18-F20, sec18-F25, sec18-F26), and the reinstatement fee is set by MVD (for example sec18-F49).
Index: exam authority in A; audience in B; knowledge facts with misconceptions, mnemonics, glossary and dynamic-fact lines in C; confusables in C2; accuracy in D; market in E and E2; definition-of-done matrix in G.
